Russia strikes Ukraine; missile lands in Poland

Russia launched overnight ballistic missile and drone attacks across Ukraine, with Kyiv reporting at least three people killed and over a dozen injured. Multiple explosions were heard in Kyiv, triggering car alarms. Simultaneously, a missile fell on Polish territory, prompting Poland to summon the Russian ambassador and NATO to scramble jets. Russia's grain lobby stated that Kyiv's attacks threaten Black Sea exports, while Ukraine has appealed against Russia's return to the Olympics.
